card.name: Linking words before duration terms
card.fires_on: Small linking words or spaces right before a time span is named, such as the 'and' in 'lowest dose and shortest duration'. Also fires in application-time tables and in 'period from 48 to 72' hours.

modes.label: Dose and duration phrase
modes.description: The word 'and' joining the lowest dose with the shortest duration of therapy.
modes.example: Patients should use the lowest dose<< and>> shortest duration of PPI therapy appropriate to

modes.label: Time slots and intervals
modes.description: A space, 'at' or 'period' just before a stated time length or interval.
modes.example: with reduced doses administered<< at>> 8-hour intervals or with normal doses

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words like 'time' and 'interval' as the next word.
card.plain: It fires on the small word just before the text names how long or how often a drug is given.
